Class AgentInferenceResponse

java.lang.Object
tech.kayys.wayang.agent.core.inference.AgentInferenceResponse
public class AgentInferenceResponse extends Object
Agent-specific inference response wrapper.

Extends the basic response with agent-specific fields:

  • toolCalls — tool invocations requested by the LLM
  • toolResults — results from executed tools (for audit/debugging)
  • finishReason — why the LLM stopped generating
  • iterations — number of ReAct loop iterations used
